name: tirion
description: Agent-first local measurement and estimated cost attribution for supported AI coding telemetry.

scripts.compile: npm run build --workspace @tirion/agent-contract && npm run build --workspace @tirion/engine && npm run build --workspace @tirion/platform && npm run build --workspace @tirion/agent-storage && npm run build --workspace @tirion/agent && npm run build --workspace @tirion/tirionctl && npm run build --workspace @tirion/distribution && tsc -p ./
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test --workspace @tirion/agent-contract && npm run test --workspace @tirion/engine && npm run test --workspace @tirion/platform && npm run test --workspace @tirion/agent-storage && npm run test --workspace @tirion/agent && npm run test --workspace @tirion/tirionctl && npm run test --workspace @tirion/distribution
scripts.tui:check: npm run tui:build && npm run tui:test
scripts.check: npm run compile && npm test && npm run tui:check && npm run audit:security
scripts.package:macos: npm run compile && npm run tui:build && npm run build --workspace @tirion/distribution && node packages/distribution/dist/main.js
